name: @whz/audio
description: Music and SFX as data, and the one reference synth that plays them: a sample-level chip synth in plain TypeScript, the wz.song and wz.sfx formats with their validators, loudness metrics, and the audio command (list, check, render, metrics).

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && eslint . && vitest run && npm run examples
